children: During the final day of Arabian Travel Market 2026 in Dubai, the Fujairah stand welcomed Sheikh Abdullah bin Hamad bin Saif Al Sharqi, who was briefed on the Fujairah Tourism and Antiquities Department’s participation and its showcase of the emirate’s diverse tourism, cultural and heritage offerings.

The participation highlights Fujairah’s position as a distinctive tourism destination and forms part of the department’s efforts to strengthen the emirate’s presence on local, regional and international tourism markets.

Through its participation in the exhibition, the department is also seeking to expand opportunities for cooperation and partnerships with tourism and travel sector stakeholders, supporting the continued development and promotion of Fujairah’s tourism offering.

title: ZAWYA: Fujairah highlights tourism offering at Arabian Travel Market 2026
